headline: DO: FINISH THE TRANSFER — most of the covering cash moved into the business account at 6:08 this morning and only the last slice of the gap is still sitting in the wrong place, with today's drafts still ahead of it. · WATCH: the 195 Lake View inspection is RUNNING RIGHT NOW — ShowingTime confirmed it at 7:46 this morning for noon today, which makes it the last real contingency on your cleanest file and the one thing on this board that changes between now and tonight. · AND THE THING THAT MOVED SINCE BREAKFAST: 198 Rena's buyer agent left a SECOND voicemail at 10:50 asking you for a counter number and naming his ceiling out loud — a buyer who names his own ceiling unprompted is negotiating with himself, and your sellers still have not answered.

notes: 🔑 FOURTH RUN IN A ROW BLOCKED BY ONE SIGN-IN, AND THE STRANDED PILE KEEPS GROWING. Both phone boards are rebuilt and committed again this run, and they still cannot publish — the GitHub CLI is signed out and the Mac keychain has held no credential for it since the migration. What you are reading on your phone is still Tuesday 8:05 AM. Everything downstream of the push works; `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, ships the whole backlog on the next pass — boards and this week's marketing graphics together.

🔇 THE WARM-15 RECONNECT LANE IS NOW FOUR DAYS DARK AND THE MIDDAY DELTA RE-FLAGGED IT AS RED. Fifteen past-client reconnects were staged Tuesday, announced to you, never vetoed and never sent; the send log's last entry is still 8/1. Two p1 tasks now carry it. It is two separate failures stacked — the executor stopped sending, AND the relationship backbone folder never came across in the migration, so today's run had nothing to stage from either. Do not simply re-send Tuesday's queue: it was built against a stale double-touch check.

🛡️ THE SHOWING BOARD'S TWO SEND-SAFETY LEDGERS ARE CONFIRMED GONE, AND THAT IS WHY NO AGENT MAIL WENT OUT TODAY — CORRECTLY. You already ruled on this Monday (option c): the board keeps building, but hits reach you as call tasks instead of machine emails, and no reconstructed or empty ledger gets written to paper over the gap. This run honoured that ruling exactly — zero outreach sent, zero ledger invented. Nothing was owed anyway: there are no new hot signals since this morning.

callBlock.why: Still the only unqualified YES anywhere on your board — her buyer wants to write on the Altamont unit and is short on down payment, nothing else. ⭐ AND THE PHONE IS NOW THE ONLY DOOR: with agent outreach suspended by your own Monday ruling, no machine will ever send this one for you. She returned your call Tuesday evening with a self-declared window, so the relationship is warm, not cold.
Brand-new buyer off the 1709 Fieldstone ad, and the email that went out in your name promised him a call TODAY. That is a clock you set yourself, and it is past noon.

You hold a SIGNED referral agreement on this seller and the listing consult you booked never happened. His task was due at 9:00 this morning and is now overdue — a signed agreement going cold is the most expensive kind of quiet on this list.

He told you "moving to Alabama spring/summer" — that window is NOW, not later — and he was back on your site three hours ago. Intent plus live site activity on the same name is as clean a buy signal as this list produces.
Asked you to call her twice inside twenty-five seconds, then followed with a slab-leak question. Two asks, still no answer.
New buyer off the Fieldstone ad and the phone is the only channel that exists — her email hard bounced, so nothing you send will ever land.
Third name that one ad produced in three days, re-engaged himself Sunday afternoon, and has never been touched a single time.
Fourth name off the same ad in four days, landed Sunday evening while the responder was still down — so nobody has ever answered her at all.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $369K — THE INSPECTION IS HAPPENING RIGHT NOW
listings.note: 🔥 CONFIRMED IN WRITING THIS MORNING: ShowingTime posted INSPECTION CONFIRMED at 7:46 AM for noon today, and the MLS line on that same notice now reads CONTINGENT. ✅ NOTHING IS OWED BY YOUR SIDE — both of Tuesday's documents are harmless: the dotloop addendum is an ADDRESS CORRECTION and the client-care fee is payable by the BUYER. Have both answers ready before either seller calls you tonight.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — the buyer's agent called a SECOND time at 10:50 asking for your counter
listings.note: 🔥 THE FRESHEST THING ON THIS BOARD. His second voicemail this morning asks for a counter number and names his own ceiling out loud. ⭐ A BUYER WHO NAMES HIS CEILING UNPROMPTED IS NEGOTIATING WITH HIMSELF — that is a gift, and it expires the moment he decides nobody is listening. ⚠️ Your sellers have now been silent on a live written offer for more than a day, and you have his number.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — the cut worked; the new showing lands tomorrow 11:00 AM
listings.note: ⭐ The first fresh booking this listing has taken since three separate buyers said the number was wrong, confirmed on the same notice that carried the new price. Tomorrow morning is the test of whether the cut bought real traffic or one curious agent — chase that feedback inside the hour.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $164K — a named buyer wants to write, and the decision is still yours to make
listings.note: 🔥 The only YES on the board. ⚠️ THE OPEN QUESTION IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS A DECISION, NOT A TASK: authorize a concession number today and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⭐ Her agent already told you in writing what the buyer needs help with.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $380K — four straight reads now, and every one blames size and layout, never price
listings.note: ⭐ SEVEN TOURS IN EIGHT DAYS ACROSS FIVE BROKERAGES and every price field on every form has come back blank. That is a photography-and-copy problem you can fix this week without touching the number — and it is far cheaper than the cut this traffic level would normally argue for. 🔥 One live buyer-side thread on it asked about competing offers and is still unanswered.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — inspections done, appraisal clean, close date settled
listings.note: ✅ The quietest file you have, and it should stay that way. A backup buyer's agent confirmed in writing Monday that her client is still interested but would need to sell first — worth knowing, not worth acting on while the primary holds.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $559K — first read since the contract died says too high, with an EIFS question behind it
listings.note: ⚠️ The fourth-tour feedback came back NO and "too high" at the current number — the first price objection since the fall-through. Two of the last three reads on this house now disagree with the price.

listings.client: Six named buyers in five days
listings.status: 🔥 Still your best lead source — and the phone, not the ad, is the bottleneck
listings.note: ⭐ The ad keeps producing named, phoned, reachable buyers faster than anyone is calling them. Four of them are sitting on today's call block untouched. ⚠️ This is not a marketing problem.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $189K — the approved cut is now thirteen days old and still unverified
listings.note: 🔴 THE RISK IS TWO PUBLIC PRICES, NOT A SLOW SALE. A cut was approved almost two weeks ago with no receipt anywhere that it took effect in the MLS — on a listing whose only written read said the price was too high. ✅ Two minutes to pull the MLS line and close it.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $364K — a read validated your price a week ago and the seller still has not been told
listings.note: 🔴 DAY SEVEN OF A SELLER NOT HEARING GOOD NEWS. A price validated by someone with no reason to flatter it is exactly what an out-of-state condo seller wants to hear. ⚠️ A validated price with no buyer is a marketing conversation — and you cannot have it with someone who does not know the price was validated.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — she called Friday and the tenant answer is now thirteen days owed
listings.note: 🔴 A CLIENT WHO HAS TO CHASE TWICE ON SOMETHING ORDINARY STARTS ASSUMING THE HARDER QUESTIONS WILL GO THE SAME WAY. Sixty seconds, whether or not you have the answer — "here is where it stands and here is when you will have it" resets the clock honestly.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — Sunday's open house is five days back and nothing has captured what happened at it
listings.note: ⚠️ Your most expensive listing, sellers living in it, and the only event it has had in a week is unrecorded. Whatever happened Sunday exists only in your head right now.

listings.addr: New Lot-Land listing — signed Monday 4:38 PM
listings.client: ⚠️ seller verified, property still unnamed on the paperwork
listings.status: 🆕 A signed listing agreement that no system in the fleet can see — day three
listings.note: 🆕 The signature is real and receipted; the parcel is not named anywhere in the document. ⚠️ Until it has an address it cannot be marketed, cannot be counted, and cannot be watched by any routine — it is inventory that exists only as a promise.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side — the largest number on your board, and your written position still has not gone across
listings.note: 🔴 Your own message told the other side you would entertain a reverse offer — a real position stated verbally with nothing on paper behind it. The written feedback they have asked for five times IS your negotiating position; writing it is not a favour to them.

listings.status: 🆕 New cash deal — offer package delivered 9:12 this morning, price per acre still unagreed
listings.note: 🆕 He signed Monday evening and opened the package. ⚠️ THE PRICE GAP IS STILL OPEN AND THE ACREAGE IS STATED NOWHERE IN WRITING — which means no one in this system can compute what the deal is actually worth. Two conditions you promised him by text are now your written obligations.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED — and the feedback you owe the other agent is now openly overdue
listings.note: 🎉 Closed and funded. ⚠️ The listing side asked for feedback three times and never got it. ⭐ The closing changed what that silence means — before it read as an oversight, now it reads as a shrug at the agent across the table.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED 7/30 — day eight, and the money still has not reached the bank
listings.note: ⚠️ A closing with no receipted commission a week later is the shape of a problem, not a delay — especially in a week where the business account is the constraint.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED + FUNDED — both clean, both counted
listings.note: ✅ Nothing owed on either.

listings.status: 🆕 Buyer-side pending — the forecast found GCI nobody was counting
listings.note: ✅ Real money already on the board that had been missing from the count.

listings.addr: 225 Willow Point Cir · 3035 County Line Rd · 104 95th St N · 361 White Oak Cir
listings.status: Active — quiet, confirmed yours, and one of them has a listing appointment waiting on you
listings.note: ✅ THEY APPEAR HERE ON PURPOSE RATHER THAN BEING DROPPED — a listing that vanishes because nothing happened is how a seller goes ninety days without a call. 🔥 THE WILLOW POINT SELLERS ASKED FOR A LISTING APPOINTMENT AND NAMED THREE OPEN WINDOWS THEMSELVES — list one, buy another, and the ball has been in your court since last Tuesday. Send a time, not a question.

listings.status: ⚠️ RE-ATTRIBUTED — these belong to teammates and should not count against your numbers
listings.note: ✅ Corrected and holding.

listings.status: 🛡️ Buyer-side — suppressed from the milestone engine, correctly
listings.note: ✅ The roster labelled you listing agent; four receipts say the other side holds the sellers. The guard went in before a wrong milestone could fire a seller email at someone who is not your seller.

pipeline.note: ✅ THE COUNT IS SETTLED AND SHOULD NOT BE RE-LITIGATED — Monday's Weekly Pipeline & Forecast led with "THE COUNT IS SETTLED: GENE = 21. ACCOUNT-WIDE = 35," the item three consecutive weekly reviews called the fleet's worst bug, running end to end for the first time in roughly 21 days. ⭐ 21 at day 217 is about 5.5 behind an on-pace 26.5 and annualises to 36. ⏰ THE REAL DEADLINE IS NOT DECEMBER 31 — at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything counting for 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31, which is 12.2 weeks out. 🔥 AND THE ONE NUMBER THAT MOVES IT IS APPOINTMENTS: roughly 3.4 a week for 13 weeks. ⭐ THERE ARE STILL THREE REAL SHOTS AT ONE SITTING ON THIS BOARD — a seller who named three open windows herself and is waiting on you to pick a day, a Lot-Land agreement signed Monday whose parcel still has no name, and a land buyer on your own call list who has been hunting for two and a half years. Two of the three are waiting on a single message from you, and none of them moved this morning.

money.note: 🟡 THE TRANSFER IS MOSTLY DONE AND THE LAST SLICE IS STILL YOURS. Money moved out of the personal account and into the business account at 6:08 this morning, which closed the large majority of the gap before the drafts post today — what is left is a small remainder, not a crisis. ⭐ IT IS STILL A TRANSFER, NOT A DECISION, and it is still the highest-value five minutes on this board. ⚠️ THE CATEGORY SHIFT IS THE PART WORTH SITTING WITH: every returned item on this system until Monday was personal-side; the notice that arrived this week is addressed to the company and carries a fee alongside it. That is a threshold crossed, not a bad day — and a second business notice from Tuesday evening is still sitting behind a bank login, naming no merchant and no date, so nothing about it has been independently verified. ⚠️ A low-balance notice fired again overnight on the personal side, the second consecutive night. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS NOT THE PROBLEM — August models above the survive line for the first time this year. September is the hole and it is still sitting at zero, which is exactly what the appointment number on this board is for. ⭐ SO: a timing problem inside a good month, and one closing from last week whose money still has not landed.

isa.decayPolicy: ⚠️ UP TO 30 FROM 27 THIS MORNING, AND THE COMPOSITION MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBER. Thirteen of the thirty are p1. ⭐ THE LIST IS MOSTLY REAL WORK RATHER THAN ROT: six are contactless address-only seller records queued for re-check — records that arrived with no name, no phone and no email, so they were correctly held at zero touch rather than guessed at — and several more came straight off live text threads you were working in real time. 🔥 THE p1 BLOCK IS WHERE THE MONEY IS: four are named buyers off a single listing ad, one is a co-op agent holding a live buyer who wants to write, one is a signed referral whose consult never happened, and one is a buyer who told you his move window is now. ⚠️ ONE NAME ON THIS LIST STILL SHOULD NOT BE CALLED — a lead ruled a duplicate database record and formally claimed by a teammate is carrying a p1 it should not have. It belongs closed, not dialled.
isa.sweepCadence: Every ~30 minutes through the send window, plus the instant responder on inbound. ✅ SEVEN REAL TALK TOUCHES WENT OUT THIS MORNING — the first wave since the window opened at 8:00 — so the send lane is demonstrably alive, not just reporting alive. ✅ THE LEAD LANE HAS READ DRY ON EVERY PASS TODAY, verified two independent ways each time; that is a quiet lane confirmed, not a broken one. ✅ THE RESPONDER IS FULLY ALIVE and fired on every new seller record. ⚠️ BUT ALMOST EVERY ONE OF THOSE RECORDS WAS ADDRESS-ONLY with no name, email or phone attached — held at zero touch for lack of any channel rather than for lack of trying, which is the right call and also a real inventory problem. 🔇 THE WARM-15 RECONNECT LANE REMAINS THE EXCEPTION AND IS FOUR DAYS DARK.
